Container.Name: shelflife
Container.Overview: Find the biggest, least-watched movies and TV shows in your Plex libraries. Shelflife reads watch history from Tautulli, lists everything nobody has watched in a while (or ever), sorted by size on disk, and keeps a list of titles you never want to see in the cull list. Optionally connects to Sonarr and Radarr to delete titles and change monitoring.
Container.Requires: A running Tautulli instance connected to your Plex server.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database (keep list, settings, cached history) and poster cache.

Config.Name: Tautulli URL
Config.Description: Base URL of Tautulli, including any HTTP root, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8181

Config.Name: Tautulli API key
Config.Description: Tautulli → Settings → Web Interface → API key.

Config.Name: Plex token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Reads file sizes straight from Plex (much faster syncs for big TV libraries, counts every version of a movie) and adds Open in Plex links. Leave blank to get sizes through Tautulli.

Config.Name: Plex URL (optional)
Config.Description: Only used with a Plex token. Leave blank to use the server address Tautulli already knows, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400

Config.Name: Sonarr URL (optional)
Config.Description: Turns on deleting shows and seasons and changing their monitoring, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8989

Config.Name: Sonarr API key
Config.Description: Sonarr → Settings → General → API Key.

Config.Name: Radarr URL (optional)
Config.Description: Turns on deleting movies, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:7878

Config.Name: Radarr API key
Config.Description: Radarr → Settings → General → API Key.

Config.Name: Sonarr link URL
Config.Description: Address your browser uses for Show in Sonarr links, if it differs from Sonarr URL (e.g. https://sonarr.yourdomain.com).

Config.Name: Radarr link URL
Config.Description: Address your browser uses for Show in Radarr links, if it differs from Radarr URL.

Config.Name: Hide deleted titles for (days)
Config.Description: Titles deleted from Shelflife stay hidden this long while Plex catches up with the removed files.

Config.Name: Sync every (hours)
Config.Description: How often to re-read libraries and watch history. You can also sync from the web UI.

Config.Name: Ignore libraries
Config.Description: Comma-separated library names or section ids to leave out, e.g. Home Videos,Kids Movies

Config.Name: Sync concurrency
Config.Description: Parallel requests to Tautulli when walking TV seasons (Tautulli-only mode).

Config.Name: Login user
Config.Description: Optional. Set this and a password to require signing in. Leave blank for no login (fine on a LAN or behind a proxy with its own auth).

Config.Name: Login password
Config.Description: Password for the sign-in page.

Config.Name: Verify SSL
Config.Description: Set to false if Tautulli or Plex use a self-signed certificate.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns files in /config.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns files in /config.
